title: Burgermeister — Owned Digital Revenue
description: Revenue system for a restaurant brand: owned digital channel strategy, loyalty mechanics, aggregator dependency reduction, local SEO, and CRM — all as one operating model.
problem: Revenue dependent on delivery aggregators taking 25–30% margin. No direct customer relationship, no loyalty system, and no owned digital channel with meaningful reach.
system: Owned digital revenue stack: direct ordering flow, loyalty program mechanics, local SEO for location-level visibility, CRM for re-engagement, and a content strategy that drives repeat visit intent.
artifact: Owned channel strategy, loyalty program design, local SEO playbook, CRM structure, and content framework for a multi-location hospitality brand.
outcome: Shift from 100% aggregator dependency toward owned revenue channels with direct customer relationships and compounding local search presence.
